competency_fulfillment.rationale: Samples cover both halves of the competency: 'read_mcq' items ('What time does the clock show?') test reading, and the 'set_fill_in_blank' item ('Set the clock to show 7:00.') tests writing/setting, matching 'read and write time' precisely.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: time_reading registers 3 axes/20 combos per variant_registry, machine-verified exhaustively by validate_matrix; the 5 sampled seeds are only illustrative of that larger space.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Both observed prompt types are extremely short, e.g. 'What time does the clock show?' is 5 words, well under the 15-word cap, appropriate for grade 1.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: 20 registered combos across 3 axes plausibly supports the three named time granularities, hour, half hour, quarter hour, combined with both read and write/set interaction formats observed in the samples.

competency_alignment.rationale: The two observed formats, reading a clock face and setting a clock to a stated time, map exactly onto the competency's two named verbs, without reaching into elapsed-time or AM/PM distinctions that belong to a later competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The one concrete time value shown (7:00) is a simple on-the-hour value appropriate as an entry point; there is no larger numeric scale concern for a clock-reading competency.
